title: Irish Soda Bread
description: Warming, fluffy soda bread made with just self-raising flour, bicarbonate of soda and buttermilk. A childhood staple — perfect alongside an Ulster fry.
steps: Sift the flour and bicarbonate of soda into a bowl. Add the buttermilk and mix, avoiding over-working.
Turn on to a floured surface, shape into a round and flatten to about 5cm thick.
Transfer to a greased baking tray and score a large cross on top (0.5cm deep).
Bake at full temperature for 10 minutes, then lower to 190°C/170°C fan for 20 more minutes.
Test with a skewer — if clean, it's done. Cool on a rack.
notes: Serves 8–10. Serve with butter, cheese or jam. To make your own buttermilk: 285ml milk + 1 tbsp lemon juice, whisk.
